correctness.rationale: The source Eq (3.2) gives exact original-axis derivative exponents alternating in blocks of lengths γ^(m+j), so L_n(x,e1,2)=c±d S_n/n. Normalize block endpoints T_j and obtain uniform compact-away-from-zero signed-walk scaling Φγ on γ-adic intervals. Integrate S_n/n by Riemann sums to obtain Hγ(z) on z∈[1/γ,1]. Its derivative has one critical point z*=γ^(−γ/(γ+1)) where Hγ=−Rγ; endpoints ±Dγ and alternating block parity fill exactly [−Rγ,Rγ]. Weighted double sum Σ S_n/n² differs from alternating harmonic blocks by O(1); each geometric block contributes ±logγ+ summable error, giving Q_N=c+O(1/logN). Domain is source full-measure regular wandering rectangle and original two axis directions only.
